name: G2
description: The G2 MCP server brings real-time Buyer Intent and review insights into AI workflows. It lets AI summarize in-market buyer research, competitive interest, and customer sentiment from the G2 platform. Teams can automatically prioritize accounts, personalize outreach, inform messaging, and uncover market trends—turning trusted, first-party buyer data into action.

_published_faq.name: How do I add G2 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add G2 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.g2.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the G2 MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: G2 provides these MCP tools: browse_competitive_intelligence, browse_product_buyer_intent, list_categories, list_my_products, list_product_reviews, list_products, show_category, show_product, and show_product_review.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to G2?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to G2 in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
G2 requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
G2 is developed by G2. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
